# StainSolver

> Stain-removal first moves tailored to the stain, the fabric and how old the stain is, with practical steps and source-backed safety guidance.

Guidance is conservative: always spot-test hidden areas first and follow the garment care label.

## Start here

- [Stain Solver | Stain removal by fabric and spill](https://stainsolver.shop/): Spilled coffee, wine or grease? Get a stain-removal first move tailored to your fabric. Three quick choices, practical steps, and source-backed safety guidance.
- [Our method and sources | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/about/): How Stain Solver turns public cleaning and textile-care resources into conservative fabric-aware first steps, with safety rules and references.
- [Stain removal guides | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/): Care-aware guides for common spills on cotton, denim, sofas, carpet, wool, silk and more. Browse by stain and material.
- [Privacy and offline use | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/privacy/): Stain Solver is free and accountless. Your saved stain plans live in your browser; there are no analytics trackers or external user accounts.

## Stain guides

- [How to handle blood on synthetic carpet | Stain Solver](https://stainsolver.shop/guides/blood-on-carpet/): Avoid bare-handed contact with blood. For a small spill you can handle safely, use protective gloves and blot without rubbing; otherwise seek professional help. See care-label checks, material-specific steps, what to avoid and when to stop.
